upload_markdown.description: Upload a file for use in markdown content. Use this for the specific operation described; choose a sibling tool when you need a different resource or lifecycle action. It changes remote GitLab state and requires the necessary project or group permission; GitLab returns validation, conflict, permission, or rate-limit errors instead of silently applying an invalid request. When `project_id` or `group_id` is accepted, provide the numeric ID or complete URL-encoded path described by the schema; use required identifiers and pagination fields exactly as documented.

file_path.description: Path to the file to upload

project_id.description: Project ID or URL-encoded path of the project
